notes: §1985:VI.6.27.2 prints UNSTRING identifier-1, [DELIMITED BY [ALL] identifier-2/literal-1 [OR [ALL] identifier-3/literal-2]...], INTO {identifier-4 [DELIMITER IN identifier-5] [COUNT IN identifier-6]}..., [WITH POINTER identifier-7], [TALLYING IN identifier-8], [ON OVERFLOW ...], "[ NOT ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-2 ]" and [END-UNSTRING], in that order (§1985:IV.2.1). unstringStatement and its phrase rules fix the phrase sequence and BindUnstring binds every phrase; the gap the prior PARTIAL named (NOT ON OVERFLOW before ON OVERFLOW accepted) is closed by kb/Work PB5158: ConditionalPhrases.OutOfPrintedOrder feeds ParseArm.VisitConditionalPhrases, which refuses the reversed pair below 2002 (COBOL0900), and VisitUnstringStatement refuses a reference-modified identifier-1. Probed at --std 85 (classes a, b, c, d, f): the full format with optional words omitted runs (T1=AB T2=CD T3=EF, D1=',', C1=02, pointer 21, tally 03, NOT ON OVERFLOW taken); ODO-table receivers TE(N), a numeric, a group and a reference-modified receiver get their fields; pointer 0 and 21 take ON OVERFLOW, 20 takes NOT; refused: NOT before ON (0900; accepted at 2002), TALLYING before POINTER, COUNT before DELIMITER, INTO twice, DELIMITED twice, DELIMITED BY SIZE, an empty INTO, a literal identifier-1, a repeated ON OVERFLOW, ALL ALL and a numeric delimiter. The witness runs DELIMITED BY ALL, DELIMITER IN, COUNT IN, TALLYING and both OVERFLOW phrases. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-07.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-07-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "[ ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-2 ]"; 2023: "brackets with choice indicators: zero or more ... each at most once, in any order". Format otherwise identical. 1985 fixes ON OVERFLOW before NOT ON OVERFLOW; 2023 choice indicators also accept NOT ON OVERFLOW first, so more programs are accepted.
